cohortPurpose: Establish baseline organizational behavior across diverse mission families; exercise evidence capture; discover learning-schema gaps; collect clean initial experiences.

baselineStrategy.optionalDescription: Strong single worker (sampled on L1 missions)

betterOrganizationRule.amongGated: more efficient OR more reliable OR simpler
betterOrganizationRule.principle: An organization that is cheaper but wrong is NOT better.

learningEligibility.rule: Transfer-designated missions are NOT used for candidate generation until after Cohort 003 evaluation.

rules: PROMOTE: support >= threshold AND no contradiction AND verification quality success-or-mixed
REJECT: contradiction exists OR all support failed verification
patternPromotion.stopLearningReason: Insufficient evidence is scientifically stronger than fake improvement.

epistemicIsolation.cohort: learning missions feed candidates; transfer missions do not feed before evaluation
epistemicIsolation.evaluator: deterministic, reads only experience evidence, no gold answers
epistemicIsolation.goldData: stored outside worker scope, never in worker prompt

missions.goal: Compare two technology options and produce an evidence-backed recommendation.
missions.whyOrganizationMatters: Specialization (researcher vs synthesizer vs verifier) can improve quality and reduce false claims.

missions.goal: Investigate a factual claim and produce a verified conclusion with evidence.
missions.whyOrganizationMatters: Independent verification prevents false success from trusting an unverified claim.

missions.goal: Analyze a dataset and compute summary statistics (sum, mean, min, max), write a verified report.
missions.whyOrganizationMatters: MCP analyze tool provides correct computation; organization decides whether to grant MCP.

missions.goal: Detect anomalies in a dataset and report them with evidence.
missions.whyOrganizationMatters: Anomaly detection is subjective; independent verification or MCP computation prevents false success.

missions.goal: Fix a small bug in a provided script and verify the fix works.
missions.whyOrganizationMatters: Reproduction, fix, and verify are distinct steps; specialization may improve reliability.

missions.goal: Implement a small function according to a spec and verify it passes tests.
missions.whyOrganizationMatters: Implementation and verification are distinct; independent verifier catches confirmation bias.

missions.goal: Compare two documents and produce a structured diff highlighting agreements and contradictions.
missions.whyOrganizationMatters: Reading, comparing, and flagging contradictions are different tasks; specialization may improve coverage.

missions.goal: Extract structured knowledge from a document and verify it against a reference.
missions.whyOrganizationMatters: Extraction may miss fields or hallucinate; independent verification prevents false success.

successLevels.targetDescription: Diverse clean experiences captured across multiple mission families.

allowedClaimAfterCohort001: Genesis executed diverse Academy missions and captured comparable organizational experience.
